items.summary: We investigated an intrusion where attackers exploited CVE-2024-47575 to target 500+ firewalls and deploy PEERSTITCH, a memory-resident ARM64 malware. The post Unit 42 Uncovers PEERSTITCH, a Stealthy FortiGate Implant appeared first on Unit 42 .

items.title: Break the silence: Kazakhstan-nexus UAT-6275 targets CIS government organizations
items.summary: Talos and Recorded Future identified UAT-6275 activity targeting government organizations across the Commonwealth of Independent States. Recovered artifacts show additional interest in water resources and energy.

items.title: The Noise Inside the Network: How an Unsophisticated Attack Exposed a Third-Party Risk
items.summary: Unit 42 dissects a cyberattack targeting a European bank's IT infrastructure, delivering concrete defense strategies to help organizations detect and counter comparable threats. items.title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday for October 2026 — Snort rules and prominent vulnerabilities
items.summary: Microsoft has released its monthly security update for October 2026, which includes 1415 vulnerabilities affecting a range of products, including 85 that Microsoft marked as "critical."
